name: Room areas
about: Every room of a project with its level, name, use, net area (inside the walls) and gross area (to the wall centre lines) in m², with totals for each level and the project. Leaves out uses that are not rooms (plot, footprint, void). Notes a room with no name or no use, a wall whose thickness is not known, and a curved side (its net area is approximate). Nothing is changed.
useWhen: The owner wants the list of a project's rooms with their areas (an area schedule), or the total net and gross area.
